headline: Argentina Suspends ARCA Tax Seizures Until May to Ease Fiscal Burden
summary: Economy Minister Luis Caputo announced that tax seizures by the ARCA agency are suspended until May as part of a package to ease tax burdens on contributors.
why: ARCA is Argentina's federal tax and customs authority, and modifications to its collection enforcement directly affect corporate liquidity and taxpayer compliance burdens.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Suspending tax enforcement measures provides temporary cash flow relief to commercial entities operating in Argentina.
